description: This file defines the EmpPicture entity class, which represents employee images in the system. It includes properties for storing image data, filename, type, size, and dimensions, along with getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and a decorator trait.

classes.name: EmpPicture
classes.description: Entity class representing employee pictures, mapped to hs_hr_emp_picture table. Contains properties for image data, metadata, and relation to Employee entity.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with this picture.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Retrieves the picture data, which can be a string or a resource.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Gets the filename of the picture.
